local.title: Local Homey connection
local.description: Connect directly to a Homey Pro on the local network for the lowest latency. Configure the URL and write-only API key here; Smart Panel must be able to reach Homey.

cloud.title: Homey Cloud connection
cloud.description: Connect through Homey Cloud when direct network access is unavailable. Register an OAuth client with Homey, then save its credentials here; the client secret is write-only.

url.label: Local API URL
url.required: Enter the Homey local API URL
url.invalid: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials

apiKey.label: Local API key
apiKey.placeholder: Enter a new key to replace the configured key
apiKey.required: Enter or keep a Homey API key before enabling the integration
apiKey.invalid: Enter a non-blank API key or remove the replacement

cloudClientId.label: Homey Cloud client ID
cloudClientId.required: Enter the Homey Cloud client ID

cloudClientSecret.label: Homey Cloud client secret
cloudClientSecret.placeholder: Enter a new secret to replace the configured secret
cloudClientSecret.required: Enter or keep the Homey Cloud client secret
cloudClientSecret.invalid: Enter a non-blank client secret or remove the replacement

cloudRedirectUrl.label: Homey Cloud redirect URL
cloudRedirectUrl.description: Register this exact URL as the OAuth callback in the Homey Developer portal.
cloudRedirectUrl.invalid: Enter the exact registered HTTPS callback URL; HTTP is allowed only on localhost

validation.connectionTimeoutRange: Connection timeout must be between {min} and {max} ms
validation.reconciliationIntervalRange: Inventory reconciliation interval must be between {min} and {max} ms

cloudAuthorization.title: Homey Cloud authorization
cloudAuthorization.description: Authorize Smart Panel with Homey, then select the Homey to display and control when your account has more than one.
cloudAuthorization.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Homey Cloud and remove its stored OAuth credentials?
cloudAuthorization.saveCloudModeFirst: Save cloud mode before starting Homey authorization.
cloudAuthorization.saveConfigurationFirst: Save the Homey Cloud configuration before starting authorization.
cloudAuthorization.selectDescription: Choose which Homey Smart Panel should use.
cloudAuthorization.requestFailed: The Homey Cloud authorization request could not be completed.

status.title: Connection status
status.description: Operational state reported by the saved Homey integration.
status.loadFailed: The current Homey status could not be loaded.

guidance.authentication: Reconnect Homey Cloud or replace the saved local API key, then test the connection again.
guidance.authorization: Confirm that the cloud grant or local API key has the required Homey read and control permissions.
guidance.timeout: Check the Homey address, network path, and connection timeout.
guidance.unavailable: Check that Homey is running and reachable from Smart Panel.
guidance.protocol: Confirm that the configured endpoint is a compatible Homey local API.
guidance.validation: Review the URL and connection settings.
guidance.unsupported: The connected Homey API is not supported by this integration.

connectionTest.title: Test connection
connectionTest.description: Test the selected connection already saved on the server. Local mode can also test the complete URL and new key entered above.
connectionTest.savedUnavailable: Save and complete the selected connection mode before testing its configuration.
connectionTest.candidateUnavailable: Enter both a valid URL and a new API key to test unsaved settings.
connectionTest.requestFailed: The connection test request could not be completed.

config.updateFailed: Homey configuration could not be updated

wizard.title: Add Homey devices
wizard.subtitle: Select supported devices from the connected Homey inventory

errors.inventory: The Homey inventory could not be loaded
errors.adoption: The selected Homey devices could not be adopted
errors.nameTooLong: Device name must not exceed {max} characters
errors.mappingChanged: The device mapping changed; refresh the inventory and review its category
errors.panelMetadataUnavailable: The existing panel device metadata is unavailable; refresh the inventory and try again
